Result is a technically-correct but visually-misleading admin readout for the next many weeks: even after 5-10 REAL ships with meter data, avg = 50-200 / (331+N) ≈ 0.1-0.5 lines/ship, which will read as 'ORA still ships 0-line changes'. Not a blocker for T1 acceptance (the line-string shape is correct and ship_count is >0), but material for whichever human reads this dashboard next.

critical_code_review_comments: MessageBubble.jsx renders 'HTTP <status>: <raw JSON body>' as a plain code/pre block when the API returns a structured detail payload — this is the primary 'plain-English bar' violation on this pass. Suggest: if the response body parses as {detail: string}, render the detail string only (with the themed action panel below) and drop the 'HTTP xxx: {…}' wrapper. Applies at least to 401/403/404/409/429/5xx from /chat/stream and /chat/*.

TopBar active-project pill is not a switcher on the fixture account — either wire it to open a project picker dropdown or add a [data-testid=project-switcher-btn] elsewhere that a first-time returning user can find in <5s.

rca of the issue: Live RCA for the new HIGH-priority finding (raw HTTP 403 leak in chat bubble): (Reproduction) log in as test@aurem.dev, active project auto-selects aurem-demo/frontend which has a revoked GitHub App installation, type 'Hi' and Enter. (Observed) an assistant bubble renders literally '⚠ HTTP 403: {"detail":"This project's GitHub App access isn't available — the installation may have been revoked or doesn't cover this repo. Open Projects → APP to reconnect via the AUREM GitHub App."}' and BELOW it a well-designed themed 'GitHub access for this repo is unavailable. Connect it via the AUREM GitHub App — one popup, no tokens to manage. [Connect GitHub App]' panel with a CTA button. (Root cause candidate) MessageBubble.jsx's error-rendering path is treating the /chat/stream API's structured error response as raw prose (falling back to `HTTP ${status}: ${JSON.stringify(body)}`) instead of parsing the {detail:string} shape and delegating to the themed reconnect panel that's already wired directly below. (Mitigation) In MessageBubble.jsx (or wherever /chat/stream errors are formatted into assistant bubbles), detect JSON-shaped detail bodies and render ONLY the detail string when the themed action panel is also going to render — suppress the 'HTTP xxx:' prefix and the JSON braces to meet the persona's 'no raw errors' bar.
